name: slopocop-code
description: Slop cop for code — finds and strips the AI-authorship fingerprint in source without changing behaviour: redundant comments, defensive bloat, one-implementation abstractions, generic naming, banner comments, copy-paste blocks. Ships a deterministic 0-100 scanner across seven languages, dependency-free. Use before a review or a merge when code was AI-drafted and reads like it. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.
